name: flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
description: A flickering grid background drawn on a canvas, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container (size it, e.g. `absolute inset-0 size-full`).

props.name: squareSize
props.description: Size of each square in pixels.

props.name: flickerChance
props.description: Chance per second that a square changes its opacity.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the squares (any CSS colour).

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed canvas width in pixels. Defaults to the container's width.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed canvas height in pixels. Defaults to the container's height.

props.name: maxOpacity
props.description: Highest opacity a square can reach.
